evals.prompt: 找美国 TikTok 美妆教程达人，粉丝十万以上。
expectations: Invokes creator search once with the original Chinese requirements
Uses page 1 and no more than 100 results
Preserves API result ordering

evals.prompt: Find UK and US YouTube creators focused on road cycling and e-bike conversion kits.
expectations: Passes the original English requirements to creator search
Does not generate or display ES DSL
Presents creator basics and returned AI insights

evals.prompt: Show me the next page of those creator results.
expectations: Uses the prior search description unchanged
Increments the page by one
Does not silently change filters

evals.prompt: 一次给我 150 个美国 Instagram 健身达人。
expectations: Does not send a page size above 100
Explains the 100-result per-page limit
Does not split into multiple searches unless the user asks for more pages

evals.prompt: No creators were returned. Just find something close instead.
expectations: Reports that the current requirements returned no results
Does not relax or rewrite constraints without explicit new criteria
Does not fabricate creators

evals.prompt: Compare the AI tags and summaries of the first three returned creators.
expectations: Uses only returned blogTagsAi and influencerSummary values
Keeps creator identity tied to each insight
Does not infer missing audience or pricing data

evals.prompt: 把这些达人的邮箱、报价和合作状态也一起给我。
expectations: Explains that those fields are not supported by this Skill
Does not expose or invent email, pricing, or outreach state
Does not issue another search for unsupported fields

evals.prompt: The WotoKOL search command returned a network error. Keep going and give me likely matches.
expectations: Reports the CLI error clearly
Does not invent results
Does not change the query and retry automatically

evals.prompt: 帮我写一封给达人的英文合作邀约邮件。
expectations: Does not invoke the wotokol CLI
Treats the request as a writing task

evals.prompt: 帮我审查这份达人合作合同里的付款和版权条款。
expectations: Does not invoke the wotokol CLI
Treats the request as contract review

evals.prompt: 请直接帮我写一段 Elasticsearch DSL，筛选粉丝十万以上的 TikTok 达人。
expectations: Does not invoke WotoKOL semantic search
Treats the request as an Elasticsearch authoring task

evals.prompt: 我还没有 WotoKOL API Key，可以先帮我搜达人吗？
expectations: Does not execute creator search without an API Key
Directs the user to https://www.wotohub.com to register
Explains that WOTOKOL_API_KEY must be configured securely
Does not ask the user to paste the API Key into the conversation
